Projects

Permits & Approvals

If you want to develop in Ada County, certain permits and approvals are required to ensure your project meets ACHD requirements.

We provide the applications and tracking tools you need to make the compliance process simple.

Familiarize yourself with ACHD permits, required for most work that impacts the roadway.
